stories.facts_used: Adobe Analytics forecasts $12.9bn US online sales on Black Friday (+9.2%); shoppers spent $82.5bn online 1-22 Nov (+9.1%); NRF survey: 182.7m Americans plan to shop this weekend, ~126m on Black Friday.

stories.facts_used: Electoral Commission final count published Friday: right bloc 65 seats of 130, one short of a majority; Labour-led opposition 58; newcomer Opportunity Party 7 seats holds the balance; 484,865 special votes counted of 2,931,604 cast; National 40 seats (-2), Labour 36.
stories.headline: NZ final count: hung parliament, 65 of 130
stories.verification: Reuters 27 Nov; corroborated by AP (Wellington, 27 Nov) and WSJ.

stories.facts_used: Special EU budget summit ends early with no deal on the 2028-2034 budget; Costa compromise EUR 1.78tn (~EUR 204bn cut); seven 'frugal' states boycotted the small-group format; Macron: deal by 31 Dec or nothing; EUR 45bn Ukraine loan undiscussed; talks resume 17-18 Dec.
